### Task 2: Document Daily Study Two-File Structure ✅
**Status**: COMPLETED October 17, 2025

**Work Performed:**
- Created comprehensive guides for new two-file structure (DayX.md + DayX.rs)
- Documented migration from monolithic markdown to modular format
- Provided before/after comparison with evidence
- Created implementation guide for future weeks
- **⭐ NEW**: Documented daily incremental creation workflow (not all-at-once)

**Key Workflow Change - Incremental Daily Creation:**
- **Before (Weeks 1-4)**: All files created on Day 1
- **After (Weeks 5+)**: Files created daily, one day at a time
  - Day 1: Create only Day29.md + Day29.rs + TODO.md (week plan)
  - Day 2-7: Create one day's files per day, following TODO.md
  - Purpose: Better coordination with missions, manageable daily workload, easier to adjust

**Findings:**
- New structure is pedagogically superior
- Daily incremental creation improves coordination with missions
- Week 5 serves as reference implementation
- TODO.md provides week planning and coordination
- Days 1-35 all follow two-file pattern correctly
- Structure verified with actual file inspection

**Deliverables:**
- DAILY_STUDY_CREATION_GUIDE.md (main guide - UPDATED with workflow)
